_comment: Condition names in the style rating decision letters use: clinical, eponymous and colloquial names rather than the rating schedule's diagnostic-code titles. LABELS ARE INTERNAL: every group below was assigned by this project from anatomy (the 'basis' line), not taken from an external oracle, and the set was written by the same project that maintains the lexicon. It measures two things only: how often the deterministic lexicon abstains on names outside the schedule's vocabulary, and whether it ever asserts a wrong group. Entries marked 'ambiguous' are excluded from scoring because anatomy alone does not settle them.

conditions.name: cubital tunnel syndrome
conditions.basis: ulnar nerve entrapment in the cubital tunnel at the elbow
conditions.labels: internal - authored for this project, not an external oracle

conditions.name: De Quervain's tenosynovitis
conditions.basis: first dorsal compartment tendons (abductor pollicis longus, extensor pollicis brevis) at the radial side of the wrist
conditions.labels: internal - authored for this project, not an external oracle

conditions.name: lateral epicondylitis
conditions.basis: common extensor origin on the lateral epicondyle of the humerus, at the elbow
conditions.labels: internal - authored for this project, not an external oracle

conditions.name: medial epicondylitis

conditions.labels: internal - authored for this project, not an external oracle

conditions.name: trigger finger
